entries.name: workflow-worklist-retried-wait-fence
entries.claim: The approval worklist resolves each pending approval's trigger company only at the run's current fence, so a waiting approval that staff Retry moved to a new fence is listed once, not once per PENDING fence row.

kills.name: recordCreated runs ask for approval in their own company, link only their trigger type and never restart themselves
kills.expected: a staff-retried waiting approval is listed exactly once
